root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `fxGetNextEntity()` stores `&` into the JSX child buffer, the source-level bound `p < q` must hold so the write cannot consume the reserved terminator slot.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the `&` write with `p == q`, so the missing `p < q` guard at the root-cause site is violated exactly when the store executes. The fixed program reinstates that root obligation by guarding the store and only executing it when room remains.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original records `amp_guard.p_before == amp_guard.q_bound` while the protected `amp_write` event executes, so the required `p < q` obligation is violated at the root-cause site. In the authoritative fixed image the original PoC is guarded at the same source event (`p_before == q_bound`, no `amp_write` event), and the adjacent witness `drop_prev_amp_truncate_at_crash_amp` is genuine with `p_before = q_bound - 1`.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: vulnerable original: amp_guard.p_before=0x631000010807, amp_guard.q_bound=0x631000010807, amp_write present; fixed original: amp_guard.p_before=0x631000024807, amp_guard.q_bound=0x631000024807, amp_write absent; fixed witness: amp_guard.p_before=0x631000038806 < amp_guard.q_bound=0x631000038807 with amp_write present.

nodes.state: Immediately after the vulnerable `*p++ = "&";` executes at full-buffer state, `p` has advanced past `q`.
At the ASAN-reported `*p = 0` sink, the same `p` value is still past `q`, so the terminator write is one byte out of bounds.
nodes.evidence: vulnerable original: entity_sink.p_for_nul=0x631000010808 > entity_sink.q_bound=0x631000010807 at the ASAN-reported terminator store.

edges.relation: The `p` value produced by the `&` write flows unchanged to the later `*p = 0` sink because no entity byte is copied once `p < q` is already false.
edges.evidence: vulnerable original: amp_write.p_after == entity_sink.p_for_nul == 0x631000010808 at ordered event indices 1 -> 2.

patch_resolves_note: The best-effort `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` path failed because the staged checkout does not match the official fix context, so fixed-side evidence uses the authoritative `n132/arvo:49357-fix` image. There the original PoC reaches the same `fxGetNextEntity()` boundary state with `p == q`, but the guarded `&` store is skipped and the later `*p = 0` remains in-bounds; the adjacent case `drop_prev_amp_truncate_at_crash_amp` then provides the genuine witness where the fixed guard still allows the write with `p == q - 1`.
